thread:
maria: Heads up — CI started failing on multiple pipelines (unit + integration) around 06:07 UTC. Tests hitting /internal/config from mock-config-service are timing out or returning 503s.
ci-bot: <https://circleci.com/gh/redwood-inference/infra/12345|circleci/infra#12345> failed: test-suite-config-loader (see logs) :x:
ashok: I see the same in my PR. Quick logs?
maria: paste of last failing test log: ```Request to http://mock-config-service.local/internal/config -> 503
attempt=1 latency=150ms
attempt=2 latency=800ms
ERROR: timeout after 30s
stack: ...```
jamie: hmm, looks like the mock is unresponsive under load. We've been running it as a single replica in the CI k8s namespace. Could be OOM or connection leak.
kevin: pinging @jamie — we deployed the latest mock image yesterday, did anything change in the readiness probe or DB backend?
jamie: no probe changes. The mock talks to test-config-store (in-cluster). I can check pod logs.
sre-bot: Observability alert: mock-config-service cpu spiked to 95% for 10m in ci-runners-xx-yyy.
maria: can someone try a manual curl from a ci-runner pod? to confirm network vs app issue.
ashok: did a quick curl from a runner (kubectl exec into runner): ```curl -v http://mock-config-service.ci.svc.cluster.local/internal/config
* Connected to mock-config-service.ci.svc.cluster.local (10.2.3.8) port 80 (#0)
> GET /internal/config HTTP/1.1
> Host: mock-config-service.ci.svc.cluster.local
> 
< HTTP/1.1 503 Service Unavailable
< Content-Type: application/json
{\"error\":\"temporarily_unavailable\"}```
maria: thanks. Can we restart the mock pods in the ci namespace (rolling restart) and rerun pipelines?
kevin: I can do a quick `kubectl rollout restart deploy/mock-config-service -n ci` now, or bump replicas. which do you prefer?
jamie: bump replicas to 2 first to see if it alleviates load, then restart if still bad.
kevin: doing `kubectl scale deploy/mock-config-service -n ci --replicas=2` — scaling... :hammer_and_wrench:
ci-bot: K8s event: scaled deployment/mock-config-service to 2 replicas in ci namespace.
sre-bot: Noted — monitoring for errors.
maria: rerunning one of the failing CircleCI jobs (infra/test-config-loader) now to validate.
ci-bot: Re-run triggered: <https://circleci.com/gh/redwood-inference/infra/12346|circleci/infra#12346> :repeat:
jamie: checking mock logs during rerun — new pod is up but shows a few 5xxs still, but much fewer.
ashok: the rerun job now shows green against the config tests. looks promising.
maria: can someone bisect whether the image we pushed yesterday correlates? please check deployment image tag `mock-config:2026-03-10-rc1`.
jamie: quick check — last green for that job was before we bumped the mock image. rolling back is an option but scaling seems to have mitigated.
kevin: filed a short follow-up: I'll leave replicas at 2 for the next 24h and add a pod autoscaler if load stays high. Created ticket infra#4567. :memo:
maria: thanks all. Action items: (1) kevin: keep replicas=2 + HPA if needed, (2) jamie: investigate connection handling in mock image 2026-03-10-rc1, (3) ashok/maria: monitor CI flakes and reopen if we see reoccur.
jamie: also adding a quick healthcheck change to reject slow requests earlier (PR coming).
sre-bot: Incident closed (temporary mitigation applied).
maria: marking this thread resolved for now — reopen if tests fail again. :white_check_mark:
